== Description ==
Glongoflorp-60 is one of the ''Admin Entities'' in '''Rooms: Found Footage: RENOVATED'''.

== Appearance ==
Glongoflorp-60 looks like a face with a lime outline, Glongoflorp-60 looks sad with lime teeth and lime eyes with black pupils.

== Behavior ==
When its spawned by an admin. It will play a boom sound before rushing to the current room at fast speeds, breaking the door no matter what. Once it breaks the door it will then move quickly to a random locker and check it. Once Glongoflorp-60 has checked a locker it will despawn.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* if Glongoflorp-60 spawns while you are in the main room, open the door to cause it to check that room instead.
** always hide in a previous room, or you might get your locker checked
* hide immediately after you see its screenshake, since it doesn't extend [[Claustrophobia]].

== Trivia ==
* '''Glongoflorp-60's''' design uses [[w:c:r-interminable-rooms:U-10#Original|Hoax U-10]] from Interminable Rooms, but hue shifted to green
